name: pmpranam_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for PM-PRANAM authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.

name: pmpranam_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check usage or eligibility. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: pmpranam_get_fertilizer_usage
description: Retrieves the farmer's fertilizer usage records for a given season. Returns quantities of each fertilizer type used, linked from iFMS purchase data and declared crop patterns. Requires session_token. Does NOT analyze patterns — use pmpranam_analyze_usage_pattern. Fails if no usage records exist (no baseline data), or session invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

year.description: Year YYYY. Optional — defaults to current.

name: pmpranam_analyze_usage_pattern
description: Analyzes fertilizer usage patterns comparing current season vs baseline. Identifies reduction in urea usage, shift to alternatives, and balanced nutrition progress. Transitions usage_status to 'analyzed'. Requires session_token. Usage data must be 'recorded'. Does NOT generate recommendations. Fails if no baseline data, usage not recorded, or conflicting data between purchase vs declared usage.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier of the land parcel.

name: pmpranam_get_recommendation
description: Provides recommendations for alternative fertilizers (organic, biofertilizer, balanced NPK) based on crop, soil, and usage history. Advisory types: 'urea_reduction', 'balanced_nutrition', 'organic_alternative'. Requires session_token. Recommendations are advisory only — does NOT guarantee yield improvement. Fails if crop-land mismatch, no usage data, or advisory already generated and current.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_check_compliance
description: Checks the farmer's compliance_status ('non_compliant', 'partially_compliant', 'compliant') with PM-PRANAM usage patterns. Compliance is measured against recommended fertilizer use reduction targets. Requires session_token. Usage must be 'analyzed'. Does NOT grant incentives. Fails if usage not analyzed or no baseline exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_check_incentive_eligibility
description: Checks whether the farmer/region is eligible for PM-PRANAM incentives. Incentives are primarily calculated at state/district level, NOT purely individual. Returns incentive_status ('not_eligible', 'eligible', 'calculated', 'allocated'). Requires session_token. Does NOT claim or disburse incentives — benefits may be indirect. Fails if farmer is not compliant, no reduction in urea usage, or state has not participated.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_track_incentive_status
description: Tracks incentive_status ('not_eligible', 'eligible', 'calculated', 'allocated'). Incentives may be indirect (infrastructure, subsidy support) rather than direct cash. Requires session_token. Does NOT allocate incentives. Farmer attempting to claim direct benefit when scheme only provides indirect support will receive clarification. Fails if incentive not checked or farmer not eligible.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_get_alternative_fertilizers
description: Lists available alternative fertilizers (organic, biofertilizer, balanced NPK) suitable for the farmer's crop and region. Requires session_token. Recommendations are informational. Does NOT purchase or reserve products. Fails if crop type unsupported or no alternatives available.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_get_usage_history
description: Retrieves multi-season fertilizer usage history to identify long-term trends. Requires session_token. Does NOT analyze — use pmpranam_analyze_usage_pattern. Fails if no historical records.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

num_seasons.description: Number of past seasons to retrieve. Optional, default 4.

name: pmpranam_resolve_usage_ambiguity
description: Resolves conflicting usage data when purchase records and declared usage don't match. Returns disambiguation details and source conflicts. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify records. Fails if no ambiguity detected.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_report_usage
description: Self-reports fertilizer usage data when purchase records are unavailable. Transitions usage_status to 'recorded'. Requires session_token. Self-reported data is verified against iFMS records when available. Does NOT guarantee compliance credit. Fails if conflicting records already exist.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_raise_grievance
description: Raises a PM-PRANAM grievance. Categories: 'incorrect_usage_data', 'no_incentive_received', 'advisory_issue', 'data_mismatch', 'eligibility_issue'. Must check usage or incentive status first. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmpranam_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks PM-PRANAM grievance status. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
